summary: FJORD DISCOVERY NORWAY AS (org. no. 918 988 890) is a private limited company (AS) based in Modalen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2017-05-11. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 79.902 (Guide- og reiseledervirksomhet); it has 7 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 657 939 and net income was NOK 304 569. CEO: Jarle Magnus Samuelsen; board chair: Magnus Ringen Samuelsen.
